item.text: [{"task_id":"2bee17df","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    empty = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    paint = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    border = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    out = grid.copy()","    h, w = grid.shape","    if border < 0 or border >= min(h, w):","        return out","    for r in range(border, h - border):","        if np.all(grid[r, border:w - border] == empty):","            out[r, border:w - border] = paint","    for c in range(border, w - border):","        if np.all(grid[border:h - border, c] == empty):","            out[border:h - border, c] = paint","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[3]},"params":{"rule":[0,3,1]},"rationale":"Paint green every complete black row or column within the one-cell outer border. Determine qualifying lines from the original grid so intersecting lines are all painted. This reproduces all three demonstrations."}]
